prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit, immutable canonical faces. First inputs canonical identity portraits, next bridge ROOM reference only, LAST exact target. Preserve exact people, age, face morphology, expression, hairstyle, signature equipment, warm skin, body poses, natural neck alignment and every connected shoulder-elbow-wrist-hand chain. No anatomy or composition changes. Farah lens anatomical LEFT, Demir comms anatomical RIGHT, Nazari and Mirza have NO eyewear. Keep heads at current scale unless a tiny adjustment is explicitly requested. Story action stays dominant. All unmentioned monitors and wrist displays OFF, inactive charcoal glass; no arbitrary graphs, bars or fake code. Use subdued sage on dark glass and aged brass. Remove bright mint/rim neon, broad green or gold wash. Every unused holo emitter dark charcoal, used emitter faint sage with no bright bloom. Preserve Demir face, complete head size, seated alignment and both supported hands. Replace foreground dots with a pending form headed "Synthetic probe". Three input fields "Value 100", "Mean 50", "Std 10". Two output rows "Absolute z-score: pending" and "Flag: pending". Rule beneath "Flag when abs(z) > 3". Keep the pointing fingertip on an unselected input field, no prefilled answer or success tick. All background screens, wrist and unused emitter off. Clean bold adventure-comic linework, flat cel shading, balanced stylized adults. Output one 1536x1024 scene.
